rv.q: The hearty stew of this poignant story about eternal love overcoming loss begins to simmer.
The rest of the cast struggles with the cardboard cut-outs they’ve been assigned: The Spoiled Daughter, The Boring Fiance, The Charming Rover, The Stern But Largely Absent Father.
Superb acting, casting, artistry, and production values make “And Neither Have I Wings to Fly” an astounding performance!

cn.t: A well-acted Irish family drama shows its age with meandering plots and dated tropes, though strong performances—particularly Hayley Rice as dutiful daughter Evie—and solid production values elevate this 1950s tale of loss and redemption.
